newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX ACCESS heating oil heats up on cold weather.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX ACCESS heating oil heats up on cold weather.

text.p: Prices for U.S. heating oil futures kept rising during ACCESS Wednesday trade, amid forecasts for below-normal temperatures next week in the Northeast and midwest, traders said.
The overnight market saw NYMEX February heating oil firm 0.07 cents a gallon to 73.50 cents as 231 lots changed hands and 249 were exchanged in all months.
Crude oil futures eased a cent to $26.61 a barrel, amid volumess of 306 lots traded and 551 lots traded overall.
Gasoline futures for February traded 72.25 cents a gallon, up 0.06 cents from its settle of 72.19 cents, as 15 lots traded.
